# OverCue 0.8.0

Persistent CDJ-3000 mods for official firmware 3.22, supporting the guarded
RK3399 and R8A7796 hardware profiles. The OverCue version appears above Display
Mode in SHORTCUT. Requires OverCue Desktop 2.0.0-beta.2 or newer.

## Included fixes

- Restores persistent installer completion on RK3399 after the successful flash.
- Restores Light Mode waveform theming and linked phrase/vocal indicators.
- Fixes long-track Stems allocation failures seen on R8A7796 over Link, while
  retaining the bounded resident cache and existing audio fallback.

The persistent installer and uninstaller are available through OverCue Desktop.
The installer keeps the mods installed across ordinary restarts.

Back up your music USB before updating. Never interrupt an update or remove
media during playback or updating. Use only one update package on a USB at a time.
